name: smartorder
description: SmartOrder — Application intelligente de gestion des commandes SAP BTP (YAAS)

scripts.hybrid: HOST=127.0.0.1 NODE_ENV=production USE_MOCK_AUTH=false SMARTORDER_ALLOW_UNAUTH_CSV=true SMARTORDER_ENABLE_DEV_ADMIN=true SMARTORDER_DEV_ADMINS=k.nadi@yaas.ma SMARTORDER_CSV_FALLBACK=true SMARTORDER_READ_SOURCE=csv SMARTORDER_READ_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS=25000 SMARTORDER_PG_POOL_MAX=5 SMARTORDER_PG_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS=60000 SMARTORDER_PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS=120000 NODE_OPTIONS="--max-http-header-size=262144" cds watch --profile hybrid
scripts.hybrid:serve: HOST=127.0.0.1 NODE_ENV=production USE_MOCK_AUTH=false SMARTORDER_ALLOW_UNAUTH_CSV=true SMARTORDER_ENABLE_DEV_ADMIN=true SMARTORDER_DEV_ADMINS=k.nadi@yaas.ma SMARTORDER_CSV_FALLBACK=true SMARTORDER_READ_SOURCE=csv SMARTORDER_READ_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS=25000 SMARTORDER_PG_POOL_MAX=5 SMARTORDER_PG_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS=60000 SMARTORDER_PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS=120000 NODE_OPTIONS="--max-http-header-size=262144" cds serve all --profile hybrid
scripts.hybrid:auto: HOST=127.0.0.1 NODE_ENV=production USE_MOCK_AUTH=false SMARTORDER_ALLOW_UNAUTH_CSV=true SMARTORDER_ENABLE_DEV_ADMIN=true SMARTORDER_DEV_ADMINS=k.nadi@yaas.ma SMARTORDER_CSV_FALLBACK=true SMARTORDER_READ_SOURCE=auto SMARTORDER_READ_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS=25000 SMARTORDER_PG_POOL_MAX=5 SMARTORDER_PG_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS=60000 SMARTORDER_PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS=120000 NODE_OPTIONS="--max-http-header-size=262144" cds watch --profile hybrid
scripts.hybrid:neon: HOST=127.0.0.1 NODE_ENV=production USE_MOCK_AUTH=false SMARTORDER_ALLOW_UNAUTH_CSV=true SMARTORDER_ENABLE_DEV_ADMIN=true SMARTORDER_DEV_ADMINS=k.nadi@yaas.ma SMARTORDER_CSV_FALLBACK=false SMARTORDER_READ_SOURCE=postgres SMARTORDER_READ_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS=25000 SMARTORDER_PG_POOL_MAX=5 SMARTORDER_PG_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_ACQUIRE_TIMEOUT_MS=30000 SMARTORDER_PG_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS=60000 SMARTORDER_PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS=120000 NODE_OPTIONS="--max-http-header-size=262144" cds watch --profile hybrid
scripts.hybrid:approuter: cds bind --profile hybrid --exec -- npm --prefix approuter-hybrid start
scripts.hybrid:all: concurrently -k -n cds,ui,router -c blue,green,magenta "npm run hybrid" "npm --prefix app/orders-ui run start:xsuaa" "npm run hybrid:approuter"
scripts.neon:check: NODE_ENV=production cds bind --profile hybrid --exec -- node scripts/neon-check.js
scripts.neon:init: NODE_ENV=production cds bind --profile hybrid --exec -- node scripts/neon-init-schema.js
scripts.neon:reset: NODE_ENV=production cds bind --profile hybrid --exec -- node scripts/neon-init-schema.js --reset
scripts.neon:deploy: NODE_ENV=production cds bind --profile hybrid --exec -- cds deploy --to postgres --profile hybrid
